description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links and rendering related content for Playwright API documentation, including functions to create markdown links for classes and members, renderer functions for different languages, and URL path helpers.

methods.name: createMarkdownLink
methods.description: Generates a markdown link to a class member documentation page, constructing the URL hash based on member type and name.

methods.name: createClassMarkdownLink
methods.description: Creates a markdown link to a class documentation page.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates markdown links for documentation, customized for the specified language and output type.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Maps programming language identifiers to relative documentation URL paths.

methods.name: formatClassName
methods.description: Formats class names for assertions based on the target language.

methods.name: assertionArgument
methods.description: Provides the argument name for assertion classes based on class name.

methods.name: renderJSSignature
methods.description: Renders function signatures with optional parameters in JavaScript style.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces relative links in content with absolute URLs pointing to Playwright documentation.
